title: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia- Season 4

reviews.author: M.i.k.e
reviews.text: tenhle "sitcom" asi nikdy nebude moje srdcovka, ale jako kulisa do práce funguje skvěle. Rozjezd celého seriálu byl sice slabší, ale teď když už vím do čeho jdu a že dostanu někdy více a někdy méně bizarní příhody pětice sobeckých a vlastně nesympatických kreténů, nemám s tím vůbec problém...70%(27.09.2023)

Kanibalismus (e01). e02: "The reason that shit hasn't been working out for us is  because we are not working with our full crew. I'm the brains, you're the looks,  Charlie's the wild card and Frank is the muscle." "Well, what's Dee?" "She's the  useless chick." "Ahhh!" "Yeaah." "Yeaa." ... "Dee, you continue to be useless." (..)  "No guys, brakes don't- brakes don't work. No. I'm saying. No. The brakes-" "Wiggle the  gas pedal." "Guys, why aren't the brakes working?" "BECAUSE I CUT THE BRAKES! WILD  CARD, BITCHEEES! YEEE HAAAAW" (Charlie kicks the door open and jumps outta van). Green  MAAAN! (...) "...is it a sex tape?" "No... yes. How do you know that?" "Because he  videotapes every chick he bangs. He's got, like, a thousand of them. I don't like 'em  though. It's mostly that horrible angle that you see in porns, you know, where it's all  balls and male ass just-" *CLAP-CLAP-CLAP-CLAP* "That is disgusting." )... "So Stop  asking me to burn the duster. IM NOT GONNA BURN IT!" (...) "Boom! Coming back from the  grave, bitch." "That's cool. What is this? What are you doing? Like Poltergeist or  something?" "Awesome, right? Craig T. Nelson!" "No, not awesome. Craig T. Nelson is the  best, dude. But Poltergeist? Pchhh!" "why?" "It's not scary. It's all about  psychological damage. Big deal. Look at me. Psychological damage up to here. Doesn't do  anything for me. Physical damage, that's what's gonna irritate people." "Yea, allright,  what do you suggest?" "If anything, maybe we tie some knives to our fingers and we get  a little more serious about this whole murder thing." "Yea. Haunting." "Haunting?!"  "We're gonna haunt." "I'm sorry, I was thinking "dead". (...) Sexistická ignorace Dee,  jakožto ženy, která přece nemůže mít co říct, sdělit, nebo mít problémy, které by se  jakkoliv blížily těm mužských protagonistů je něco, co tuhle show definuje a nikdy  nepřestane být zábava. To už dnes neuvidíte. "Frank, you knew too?" "Yeah. I knew."  "And some of the stuff you've been doing with this mannequin here, that's, like, um- to  teach me a lesson, or-" "Yeah." ... "Did I see you bang that thing?" (...) (Frank and  Mac sitting in cinema, laser tagging on dick on screen, Mac's phone rings) Mac: "Hey,  dude, where you been?" Dennis: "I'm in rehab, dude!" "Oh, yeah. Hey, that whole Jovi  thing went south so I think we're just gonna scrap the whole book ordeal." "What are  you talking about?" "I got another call, buddy." "No, no! No,, don't-" "Hello?" "Bill,  what's happening." "Who are you looking for?" "Bill, Who's this?" "Oh, this is Mac. You  got the wrong number." "Oh, my bad." "Yeah. No problem. What number were you trying to  call?" (Frank's prone rings) Frank: "Hello." Dennis: "Frank, you gotta get me outta  here, man." "Where are you?" "I'm in rehab, goddamit!" "Well, I'm in a movie, and this  broad's about to get naked. So I gotta go." (hangs up) Mac (still talking to other  dude): "Yeah, nah, that's ok." 
No pain no gain (Jesus Abs). 
"Frank, I guess you're right. The Secret's bullshit." "Yeah." "You try to help people,  and you just wind up getting screwed."(18.10.2024)méněvíce
